name: Quaking Footfall
description: Mogaru's steady footsteps pick up speed, causing the earth around him to tremble as though from a powerful earthquake.
disable: Three DC 39 Athletics (trained), DC 39 Crafting (trained), or Engineering Lore (trained) checks to brace a small structure or surface to cancel the effects of the quake in that area; DC 41 Performance (legendary) to calm Mogaru momentarily
reset: Mogaru doesn't rush this way again for 1d4 rounds.

generalAbilities.name: Quake
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Mogaru moves at least 60 feet

Effect The ground shakes in a 120ft Emanation from Mogaru's space. This creates a variety of effects, depending on where the player characters are at the time of the quake.

In most parts of the city, the ground becomes difficult terrain, and creatures on it are Clumsy 2 for 1 round.

In parts of the city with existing underground spaces (like sewers, sinkholes, or catacombs), fissures open up in the ground. Creatures in the area tumble into the resulting 40-foot-deep hole unless they succeed at a Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save.

In bays, on beaches, and in other relatively substantial but shallow bodies of water, Mogaru's movement creates dangerous waves. Creatures in the water or within 60 feet of the waterline are struck by waves that deal 3d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 35 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critically failed save, a creature is instantly swept 60 feet out to sea and 60 feet under the water's surface.
